content:
PewCB One is a desktop PCB prototyping system designed to accelerate hardware development by manufacturing PCBs at home or in the office in a few hours or less, instead of waiting days for a PCB to come back from the factory. Unlike desktop fabrication methods that rely on chemical processing, the PewCB One is more akin to a fully enclosed laser engraver housed with an integrated air filtration system. Users can perform the full process from double-sided PCB blanks to a complete PCBA at home. PewCB One highlights: Laser Wavelength – 1064 nm Average optical power – 20 W Pulse duration – ~100 ns Spot diameter – 35 μm PCB Blanks Double-sided PCB blanks with vias and plated through-holes Made of copper-clad alumina and zirconia ceramics Dimensions – 23 x 23 mm to 84 x 84 mm PCB traces – As low as 0.1mm; formed using laser ablation, a process that [...]
